import csv
from pathlib import Path

source = Path("data/sales_q3.csv")
output = Path("data/q3_won_deals_report.csv")
won_ids = {"D001", "D003", "D006", "D009"}

with source.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as infile:
    reader = csv.DictReader(infile)
    columns = reader.fieldnames or []

    # Adjust this list if your file uses another Deal ID heading.
    id_column = next(
        (name for name in columns
         if name.strip().lower().replace("_", " ") in {"deal id", "dealid"}),
        None,
    )
    if not id_column:
        raise ValueError(f"Deal-ID column not found. Available columns: {columns}")

    rows = [
        row for row in reader
        if row.get(id_column, "").strip() in won_ids
    ]

output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with output.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as outfile:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(outfile, fieldnames=columns)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)

found = {row[id_column].strip() for row in rows}
print(f"Saved {len(rows)} rows to {output}")
print(f"Found IDs: {sorted(found)}")
print(f"Missing IDs: {sorted(won_ids - found)}")
PY
